# Getting help

| Need | Where |
|---|---|
| Questions, setup help, support for the hosted instance | [Discord server](https://discord.gg/DDBGWP5fMX) |
| Something is broken | [Bug report](https://github.com/haxurus/Sentinel/issues/new/choose) |
| An idea or improvement | [Feature request](https://github.com/haxurus/Sentinel/issues/new/choose) |
| A security vulnerability | [Private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/haxurus/Sentinel/security/advisories/new) |
| Plans and billing | [Pricing page → Contact](https://sentinel.haxurus.com/en/pricing#contact) or haxurus@icloud.com |
| Privacy and data requests | haxurus@icloud.com — see the [privacy policy](https://sentinel.haxurus.com/en/legal#privacy) |

Before asking, these usually answer the question:

- [README](../README.md): features, how it works, Discord application setup.
- [Deployment guide](../docs/DEPLOYMENT.md) and [distribution rules](../docs/DISTRIBUTION.md) for self-hosted instances.
- Dashboard → History: every event shows its delivery state (`SENT`, `FILTERED`, `CHANNEL_UNAVAILABLE`, `FAILED`, …), which explains most missing logs.

Support is provided on a best-effort basis; paid plans of the hosted instance get priority. Self-hosted instances are supported through the Discord server and GitHub issues, as time allows.
